task: Only the triangular chipped corner seen in the original dataset. Texture and size may vary. Other arbitrary notch shapes are outside this task.
selection: Validation balanced accuracy, then fewer FN, then BCE; thresholds chosen only with validation.
scope: Train/validation/test image groups remain unchanged after dropping the whole out-of-scope supplemental batch. These are internal grouped regression/holdout measurements; former model results were inspected during development, so not independent field validation.
